containerDefinitions.name: chatdebug
command:
import asyncio, time, sys; from src.services.agent_checkpointer_factory import build_agent_graph_checkpointer
from src.config import settings
async def m():
  print(f'agent_graph_checkpointer_backend={settings.agent_graph_checkpointer_backend}', flush=True)
  print(f'agent_graph_checkpointer_setup={settings.agent_graph_checkpointer_setup}', flush=True)
  t0=time.time()
  print('STEP 1: build_agent_graph_checkpointer()...', flush=True)
  try:
    async with build_agent_graph_checkpointer() as cp:
      print(f'  checkpointer={type(cp).__name__} [{time.time()-t0:.1f}s]', flush=True)
  except Exception as e:
    print(f'  FAIL: {type(e).__name__}: {e}', flush=True)
  t0=time.time()
  print('STEP 2: import langgraph and create production_agent_router()...', flush=True)
  try:
    from src.services.agent_graph_service import build_production_agent_router
    router = build_production_agent_router()
    print(f'  router={type(router).__name__} [{time.time()-t0:.1f}s]', flush=True)
  except Exception as e:
    print(f'  FAIL: {type(e).__name__}: {e}', flush=True)
    return
  t0=time.time()
  print('STEP 3: invoke router with sample message...', flush=True)
  try:
    result = await asyncio.wait_for(router.ainvoke({'message': 'Hi', 'allowed_course_ids': ['cs230'], 'current_path_course_ids': ['cs230'], 'recent_messages': [], 'pending_clarification': None}, config={'configurable': {'thread_id': 'test-thread-debug'}}), timeout=60)
    print(f'  router result keys={list(result.keys()) if isinstance(result, dict) else type(result)} [{time.time()-t0:.1f}s]', flush=True)
  except asyncio.TimeoutError:
    print(f'  TIMEOUT after 60s — router.ainvoke hang', flush=True)
  except Exception as e:
    print(f'  FAIL: {type(e).__name__}: {e}', flush=True)
asyncio.run(m())
